channel.title: Shane's Daily Briefing (Private)
channel.description: A private daily news briefing: AI/Anthropic, world news, Ireland, Central Oregon, and sports (Man Utd, Seahawks). Not intended for public distribution.
channel.itunes:author: sgalligan

item.title: Daily Briefing — Thursday, October 22, 2026
item.description: Anthropic reportedly posts an $80 billion first-half loss as IPO paperwork may land this week, following its 5%-of-shares public benefit fund pledge and a pitched AI safety bill; Salesforce renames AIforce to SIforce after a White House superintelligence-branding push; Witkoff and Kushner meet Putin in Moscow as Russia releases a US detainee and the Kremlin floats November trilateral talks; Ireland braces for Storm Austen's orange warnings as the Dail votes to scrap the triple lock amid a heated Martin-McDonald exchange; Bend-La Pine schools reopen after the Silver Rail Elementary shooting as a county commissioner calls for an ICE pause; a cooler, showery Thursday follows a milder Wednesday in Bend; Como thrash Man Utd 4-1 in the Champions League, intensifying pressure on Michael Carrick; and the Seahawks, at 3-3, prepare to host the Chiefs.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Wednesday, October 21, 2026
item.description: Anthropic commits five percent of its shares to a new public benefit fund as speculation builds over an imminent Claude Fable 5.5; Salesforce launches its Hunter outbound-sales Agentforce agent and deepens its Docusign partnership; Witkoff and Kushner carry an updated peace framework to Moscow after constructive Oslo talks, clouded by Starlink-restriction allegations; Ireland braces for Storm Austen's rain warnings; most Bend-La Pine schools reopen this week while Silver Rail Elementary stays closed; a milder, showery stretch ahead in Bend before a sharp Friday cooldown; Man Utd head to Como in the Champions League after a winless run under Michael Carrick; and the Seahawks regroup at 3-3 before hosting the Chiefs.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Tuesday, October 20, 2026
item.description: Anthropic and Nscale reportedly discuss another forty-five billion dollar compute deal as Anthropic eyes an IPO; Bank of America upgrades Salesforce to Buy on Agentforce momentum and a one-and-a-half-billion-dollar annual run rate; Zelensky reopens contact with Trump envoys Witkoff and Kushner as Ukraine peace talks resume while the Gaza ceasefire's one-year mark is clouded by continued strikes; Ireland's EU budget-cut proposal draws criticism from aid groups; Central Oregon keeps healing after the Silver Rail Elementary shooting as schools prepare to reopen; mild Bend days ahead of midweek rain and a cold weekend; Man Utd under Michael Carrick stretch a winless run to six games after drawing at Leeds; and the Seahawks regroup after an overtime loss in Denver before hosting the Chiefs.
